purpose.zh: 练臀部把大腿往后抬，适合久坐的人和劈叉的后腿
purpose.en: Train your glutes to lift the thigh back, good for desk sitters and the back leg of the splits.

text.zh: 夹紧臀部把大腿抬离地面，腰不拱
text.en: Squeeze your glute to lift the thigh off the floor without arching your back

text.zh: 俯卧，一侧膝盖弯成90度，脚底朝天。
text.en: Lie face down with one knee bent to 90 degrees, sole to the ceiling.

text.zh: 只抬起几厘米，停2秒再放下。
text.en: Lift just a few centimetres, hold for two seconds, then lower.

commonErrors.zh: 用腰拱起代替臀部发力
commonErrors.en: Arching the lower back instead of using the glute.
Letting one side of the pelvis lift.

cautions.zh: 腰疼时抬低一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your lower back hurts, lift lower, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 英文名 Hip Extension 是术语，改 Prone Bent-Knee Leg Lift
口令按相位缩短（抬 0.6 s / 放 0.5 s）：抬腿 / 停住 / 放下
用户已定：改名、计时/计次、每侧/起始侧、计数单位按最终口径处理，相关待定项清除
最终口径：按真实做法定（2026-11-01）
